question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Appreciate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Appreciate"** means to recognize the full worth of something or someone; to be grateful for something. (सराहना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **I really **appreciate** all the help you've given me.
 
 
 
• **"Disvalue"** refers to considering something to be of little or no worth; to undervalue or depreciate. (महत्वहीन समझना)
 
 
• **Example: **He tends to **disvalue **the contributions of his colleagues.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Appreciate'** is **'Disvalue'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flourish** (फूलना-फलना): To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way.

 
 
• **Example:** The plants flourished in the rich soil.
 
 
 
• **Burgeon** (पल्लवित होना): Begin to grow or increase rapidly; flourish.
 
 
• **Example: **The town burgeoned into a city.
 
 
 
• **Savvy** (समझदार): Shrewdness and practical knowledge; the ability to make good judgments.
 
 
• **Example:** She is known for her political savvy.
 
 

30:Ta83,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
